items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: The group in New York was Joe Venuti and Krupa

ctx.x: You mean he could have been by himself or something?

There may have been another -- I haven't seen the picture in so long I've almost forgotten it. But there may have been another scene, possibly in conjunction with the Hall Johnson Choir, that Rex was in. Because I'm quite sure that at this time the same prejudice existed in the movies. They were too scared of what would happen when the thing played Dallas and Atlanta and who knows where else. But Rex was definitely not with the group in New York. The group in New York was Joe Venuti and Krupa, and well, the rest…

We were along about '37, before we got into your movies, and you'd been to the Glenn Island Casino and you were in New York. You talked about Duke at the Cotton Club and Andy Gibson writing for your band, right?
